table.name: party
table.summary: A table recording the political leadership and elected officials of a specific jurisdiction (likely New York State) across various years.

party_id.name: party_id
party_id.meaning: A unique integer identifier for the specific record or entity within the dataset.

year.name: year
year.meaning: The calendar year in which the listed officials were in office or the election took place.

party.name: party
party.meaning: The political party affiliation of the elected officials listed in the row.

lieutenant_governor.name: lieutenant_governor
lieutenant_governor.meaning: The name of the Lieutenant Governor serving as the second-in-command during the specified period.

attorney_general.name: attorney_general
attorney_general.meaning: The name of the Attorney General serving the jurisdiction during the specified period.
